investment_policy_en:
The portfolio managers adopt a fundamentals-driven and style-agnostic approach to investing. They focus on bottom-up research, looking for changes which other investors have failed to appreciate and situations where our perception goes against market consensus.

They focus on firms with durable growth, improving earnings potential driven by transformative change, and strong sustainability practices - believing that share prices ultimately reflect both earnings and ESG performance. The strategy blends three complementary pillars: long-term quality compounders, core large-cap defensives, and tactical relative-value trades that hedge benchmark risks and capture mispriced opportunities.

The fund aims to achieve capital growth over time.

The fund invests at least 70% (and normally 75%) of its assets, in equities of companies that are listed, headquartered, or do most of their business in Switzerland. The fund may also invest in money market instruments on an ancillary basis.
